notes.title: Pool of Madness limited demo is OUT - single-player and coop modes available! 🎱🐙
notes.content:
Occultists! We've just released a [b]limited playtest[/b] of our roguelite combining pool and cosmic horror.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/ea0f1766128a20e4f1be075c1dde8c728a42e5df.png[/img]

It features [b]single-player and coop modes[/b], made especially for Steam Couch Co-op Fest!

[h1][b]TRY IT OUT[/b][/h1]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/26037a494575f388a96043a6412d9ea4083cb5e0.gif[/img]

[b]Get the demo here:[/b]

store.steampowered.com/app/2873750/pool_of_madness/ 


[h1][b]WHAT IS THIS ABOMINATION?[/b][/h1]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/924b5ca139c5ed65912e8695e7961b0a11bfb9e9.gif[/img]

Think [b]Inscryption meets Diablo/PoE meets a twisted game of pool[/b]. A unique experience with lots of mystery, emergent gameplay and endless replayability. That's the goal for the full version of the game.

While this is the first stab at a PoM multiplayer mode and we expect A LOT to change, we feel it's already fun and we could really use your feedback as we continue building Pool of Madness into our dream game.

This is definitely one of our favourite projects we've worked on and the most unique one, so it's great to see players already appreciating the core features!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/a1131695a7d969e2ef1cf980ff7007961275b329.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/4203c595a622626b1b201c3a4069a7ee58781e5c.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/2644810ec3c401f190d9943647c2f9ff1e91b826.png[/img]

PS It works great on [b]Steam Deck[/b]!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/de65a69505abc5a9abe219e2e4f39d9f7f920e24.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]CHANGELOG[/b][/h1]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/fa0e431f5cd37ee84389f571a716862e1f523381.gif[/img]

Changes from the previous limited playtest include:
- a hotseat coop mode featuring a new totem
- new powerups
- completely new UI (still WIP, similarly to other features)
- premium pockets (that will feature increasing modifiers later down the line)
- many bugfixes


[h1][b]WHAT'S NEXT?[/b][/h1]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/a05115bb71d175ef512c1e26ba250ba5dca41963.gif[/img]

We're currently focusing on making the gameplay as much fun as possible, testing out different ideas and features, as well as working on the story in parallel. This is why these imperfect playtests are so important, as they allow us to [b]gather feedback[/b] from players around the world while the game is still in development.

Things will be rough for a while in terms of the overall presentation, until we're satisfied with the gameplay part and implement & test various features, then we'll begin focusing more on the audiovisual side of things.

[b]Thank you[/b] for taking the time to check out this crazy abomination our eldritch baby of a game! We think we have something really special here - we'd love you to help us shape it!

Want more forbidden knowledge? Check the Steam description!

notes.title: Dagon: Complete Edition - just launched on consoles together with a new timed exclusive DLC!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40401317/bd1f8c1e6494406ef57320a5d4b0654f2ffe2625.gif[/img]

Fellow scholars of all things forbidden!

"Dagon: by H. P. Lovecraft" turned out to be very successful, with over 1,700,000 downloads on Steam and 95% positive reviews. When the war broke out in Ukraine, we decided to donate all of our proceeds generated by the game and DLCs to humanitarian aid organisations, such as Voices of Children.

To thank the players for their support in this endeavour and all the positive responses, we've decided to create a brand new DLC - What The Moon Brings.

Today it premieres on consoles as a timed exclusive, together with the base game and all the DLCs, in the eldritch form of Dagon: Complete Edition. You can get it in the official shops:

https://youtu.be/yIaJBXaev8c

If you're a console player, consider grabbing a copy! And to answer a question we've been often asked on our social media: if you prefer to game on PC, we plan to release What The Moon Brings there as well at some point in the future.

We've always received a lot of support from this community, even before the initial launch, when we gathered feedback to improve the first raw versions, so thank you and hope you'll like the new DLC!

notes.title: Our latest eldritch baby has a new limited-time demo!
notes.content:
Connoisseurs of all things eldritch!

Our new game-jam-spawned eldritch baby, [b]Pool of Madness[/b], has a brand new demo and it's only available for the duration of the Endless Replayability Fest, so make sure to give it a spin!

The demo is now LIVE on our Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2873750

Pool of Madness Endless Replayability Fest Demo - [b]major updates[/b]:
[list]
[*] updated graphics, visibility & high resolution
[*] rewritten physics
[*] new feature: ability to freeze the ball (check Help), making the gameplay more dynamic and unique
[*] new phase, power bar, explosion & blood marks and other smaller changes!
[/list]
The first demo was a huge success, resulting in [b]11,000 wishlists[/b] and a very enthusiastic response from players, which was an awesome surprise, as it was a very early build of the game created within a month since the internal game jam that spawned PoM. We've used your feedback to introduce some updates to Early Demo #2 and plan to do the same with the current demo, so [b]we'll really appreciate all your opinions[/b] (here on our Steam forum, Twitter or Discord!).

Please note that Pool of Madness is very much a work in progress and we're working on improving every aspect of the game. We're sharing an updated demo so we can continue gathering feedback from players early and shape the game together. 

So... grab the demo and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Game update and Official DLC Trailer!
notes.content:
Fellow cultists!

Today we've uploaded the first game update in a long time. It contains a few fixes and improvements:
- added FPS limit when V-sync is disabled (to reduce GPU usage)
- added Shadows Quality in Options
- added the option to replay the last spoken line (middle mouse button or Y/triangle on gamepads)
- fixed a bug preventing Achievements from unlocking in some cases
- fixed the order of Trivia in the menu
- fixes in German translations
- you can now collect Trivia pieces without displaying them immediately
- added HTC Cosmos binding (please let us know if you have any problems with it!)

What's more, with the power of the Great Old Ones we traveled through time and space to plug into the mind of the 7 years old Howard Phillips Lovecraft. This is the projection of what we've seen:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_pZTW7Gw8Mo

notes.title: Dagon is a free, immersive cosmic horror adventure
notes.content: The apparently very generous and talented people over at Bit Golem have let loose a free horror adventure on Steam, an adaptation of the short story Dagon by H.P. Lovecraft. It's a game that takes place somewhere inside the morphine-addled mind of a former ship's officer, and in that way it's very much the "100% faithful adaptation of the original story" that it claims to be. Dagon takes about 30 minutes to complete... Read more.

notes.title: Dagon release date set to 24.09 + DLC announcement!
notes.content:
Fellow worshippers of forbidden lore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/b3bb3131a53560014f2e93af2a8c3cd7742c9d7a.png[/img]

[h1]Dagon has a release date![/h1]

The Lurker From Beyond, Lord Cthulhu, has ordered us to release the game on 24.09! Get ready for your fix of cosmic horror!

[h1]The Eldritch Box DLC[/h1]

We often get asked to open donations for Dagon and while we haven't decided to do it, we thought a cheap, paid DLC would be a good way to allow players to support our future projects.

Enter The Eldritch Box DLC for Dagon, which will be available on release (24.09)! You can check it out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1722010/Dagon__The_Eldritch_Box_DLC/]here[/url].

The DLC contains an ebook of Dagon and Fishead (the story that most probably inspired Dagon), two different audiobooks of Dagon, official wallpapers and more (to be announced soon).

So, if you'd like to support our work, the best way is to spread the word and wishlist the DLC!

Until next time,
Bit Golem

notes.title: We've updated the demo according to the community feedback!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40312070/0e09b2463de0aae8eb5f76c9d2440bb8a88cbd05.png[/img]

Thank you for all the valuable feedback you’ve provided us in the past couple of days! 

We’ve decided to incorporate your suggestions into the game: [b]the updated demo features optional interactions - make sure to look around the locations to discover interesting facts about H. P. Lovecraft, the process of writing “Dagon” and the story's historical setting.[/b]

Also, consider [url=https://www.facebook.com/bitgolem]liking us on Facebook[/url] to stay up to date with all our eldritch creations and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1481400/discussions/]leave your opinion on the Steam forums[/url] after you’ve played the demo - we’d appreciate it. Our main purpose of participating in Steam Next Fest is to gather as much valuable feedback from the Lovecraftian community as possible, in order to improve the final game :)

We’re currently working on VR support, so stay tuned for more and make sure to tell your friends about Dagon, if you think it’s something up their alley!
